cohort: A 30-year-old pregnant woman with newly diagnosed dilated cardiomyopathy and pulmonary arterial hypertension was admitted for elective cesarean delivery.
finding: Individualized anesthetic planning and collaborative multidisciplinary care are critical for optimizing outcomes in high-risk obstetric patients with peripartum cardiomyopathy and pulmonary arterial hypertension.
mod_finding: The combined spinal-epidural technique allowed for gradual onset of anesthesia and tight hemodynamic control during elective cesarean delivery, contributing to uneventful intraoperative and postoperative periods.
